g.text: Prospective cohort study rather than a randomized trial.
Cohort study rather than a randomized trial.
Newborn-screening venepuncture versus heel prick study was not randomized.
Multimodal hip-osteoarthritis therapy did not isolate the effect of exercise.
Corifollitropin alfa was outside the review's eligible intervention.
Vitamin B12 was given by intramuscular injection—an ineligible route.
Control received early surfactant after CPAP failure—not eligible selective surfactant.
Home BP monitoring, web communication and pharmacist care used an ineligible comparator.
Compared Nordic walking with strength and home exercise; there was no eligible control.
Mixed normotensive/hypertensive population; hypertensive subgroup results were insufficient.
Six nursing-home participants had a pressure injury at baseline despite PI-free eligibility.
Included participants with a pre-existing stage 1 pressure injury.
Hypertensive-subgroup results were absent or insufficient.
Hypertensive-subgroup results were absent or insufficient.
Hypertensive-subgroup results were absent or insufficient.
Control received surfactant early after CPAP failure rather than selectively.
Surfactant was given very early after respiratory-distress signs—not prophylactically.
Hip-osteoarthritis exercise was delivered in an ineligible perioperative context.
The randomized trial report was retracted.
Secondary analysis of data already reported by two included randomized trials.
Protocol only; full results were represented by an included study.
Bladder fluorescence cystoscopy was performed in an ineligible surveillance setting.
Smoking-cessation participants came from primary care/community mental-health sites.
Blue-light cystoscopy was evaluated in surveillance rather than the eligible setting.
IMSI-versus-ICSI trial; Cochrane did not specify which eligibility criterion failed.
IMSI in advanced maternal age; Cochrane did not specify the failed criterion.
High-magnification sperm selection; Cochrane did not specify the failed criterion.
The infant transfusion-volume trial did not report an eligible review outcome.
NRT requests, 1-week abstinence and quit attempts were not eligible review outcomes.
Within-person comparison assigned intervention and comparator to the same participant.
B Examples: study and Cochrane exclusion reason
